name: The Realm of Samsara
source:
You awaken one morning to a world utterly transformed. The city is empty. The streets are silent. Reality itself has fractured into a place known only as The Realm of Samsara.

Here, existence is divided into six mysterious Factions: Deva, Human, Asura, Beast, Hungry Ghost and Hell. 

You must explore this mysterious world, unlock your hidden potential, and uncover the truth behind Samsara — all while conquering the many beauties drawn to you.

[From [url=https://mark8979.itch.io/the-realm-of-samsara]Itch.io[/url]]
